settings.tab_content: Tested under rigorous MIL-STD-810H drop parameters. Guarantees phone protection across multiple drops onto steel-faced concrete blocks.
Equipped with N52 neodymium magnet rings. Snaps securely to any magnetic charger or mount while allowing full 15W high-speed charging throughput.
Internal graphite patterns and micro-grooves disperse phone heat, preventing CPU throttling or battery degradation during heavy gaming sessions.
Matte laser-etched carbon side-rail grids guarantee a solid grip even in wet conditions, preventing accidental drops before they happen.
